snippet.title: Dude, Trust Me | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Dude, Trust Me is a 3-player co-op puzzle game where one goes blind, one goes deaf, and one loses their voice. Work together, misunderstand each other, and solve puzzles nobody can complete alone.

Grab two friends and put your friendship to the test.

#DudeTrustMe #Coop #PuzzleGame
